dct_description_sm: Depicts areas in Riverside County desingated as Indian Lands, based on the Public Land Survey System to align with the Township, Range, and Sections as they are described. Data was downloaded from the Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA) website, then clipped with Riverside County boundaries. Please note that some tribal lands go beyond Riverside County boundaries. Data was last confirmed on 10/1/2015 and processed by RCIT-GIS, Emily Lee.
